verdict.summary: Round 1's major finding is resolved. Enforcement now keys both sensitive features and test-leg coverage by (crate, feature), so a same-named feature in another crate cannot satisfy the guard. The new hermetic regression test exercises the real cmd_enforce path, checks the detector preconditions, proves the cross-crate collision fails, and covers both nonblank and blank test-reason behavior. The sparq-py/arrow exception is narrowly documented and corresponds to the existing gating maturin-built Arrow pytest job. The focused 59-test feature-matrix-tier suite passes.
